The Playbook

Small choices, better callbacks.

01

Lead with impact, not duties.

"Managed a team" says little. "Led a 6-person team to ship 40% faster" says everything. The AI rewrites your bullets around outcomes, not job descriptions.

02

Tailor it to the role, every time.

Paste the job description and KAVOX re-weights your CV toward what that specific employer is scanning for — without inventing anything.

03

Numbers earn trust faster than adjectives.

"Significant growth" is a claim. "27% growth in six months" is a fact. We flag every line that could take a number and doesn't have one yet.

04

One page, unless the role says otherwise.

Templates auto-compress or expand based on your experience level, so the layout never forces you to pad — or cut — what matters.

We do not write CVs.
We craft the opening chapters — of extraordinary careers.
